changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'COMPANY_PURCHASES' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r2 ON rr.role_id = r2.id JOIN resources res2 ON rr.resource_id = res2.id WHERE r2.code = 'ADMIN' AND res2.code = 'COMPANY_PURCHASES' );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('READ', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'COMPANY_PURCHASES' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations rro WHERE rro.role_resource_id = rr.id AND rro.operation_id = o.id );
